chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David.
chapter.v:
Answer me
when I call, God of my righteousness.Give me relief from my distress.Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

You sons
of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor?Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

But know
that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly;Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

Stand in
awe, and don’t sin.Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

Offer the
sacrifices of righteousness.Put your trust in Yahweh.

Many say,
“Who will show us any good?”Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

You have
put gladness in my heart,more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

In peace
I will both lay myself down and sleep,for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
